title: MCPiler Manifest schema value
$comment: Deliberately permissive. Schema values are carried verbatim so an unknown vendor keyword and a lexically preserved numeric bound survive a load/store round trip unchanged. Constraining the keyword set here would make this document stricter than the reader and would break valid manifests in an editor. The one rule that is a genuine format rule is that a reference is a local JSON Pointer fragment: there is no cross-section reference, no base URI and no fetch in this format.

$ref.description: Fragment-only JSON Pointer resolved inside the same section document.
